blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A man wanted for five counts of rape was arrested on Monday in Misamis Oriental after two years of hiding, police said Thursday. Col. Al Abanales, Misamis Oriental Police Provincial Office (MORPPO) Director, said personnel of the Opol Municipal Police Station, Provincial Intelligence Unit, and 2nd Provincial Mobile Force Company arrested the suspect, identified only as alias “Marlo,” 53, a resident of Cagayan de Oro City. The suspect was arrested on the strength of warrants for three counts of rape, for which no bail was recommended, and two counts of rape by sexual assault under Article 266-A(2) of […]...
